headline: Accepted LeftField's October 2026 report on Priority One school projects, including schedules and budgets.
summary: LeftField gave an update on several Priority One school projects. Hillside's addition is on track for completion by the end of November, and Beech Street's groundbreaking is set for November 17 at 10:30 a.m. A $750,000 city plan to develop the Hillside field after construction was also discussed.
decisions: Accepted the monthly status and financial report for the period ending October 2026 and sent it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School Committee for informational purposes.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of School Committee Member Turner, duly seconded by School Committee Member Hamer, it was voted to accept the report and submit it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School Committee for informational purposes.

decision_titles: Monthly status and financial report for October 2026
transcript:
## COMMITTEE ON JOINT SCHOOL BUILDINGS

November 10, 2026 at 5:00 PM

Chairman O’Connell called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Alderman Bonilla, School Committee Members O’Connell, Turner, Hamer

Absent: Aldermen Fajardo, Thomas

Messrs.: H. Cobanoglu, C. Babyak

1. Presentation from LeftField regarding the School District Priority One Project to date.

Hamdi Cobanoglu, Senior Project Manager at LeftField: Good evening, Mr. Chairman, and members of the committee.

Carey Babyak, SMMA: I'm taking over for Jennifer Soucy with SMMA.

H. Cobanoglu: First, I would like to apologize in advance, as I'm filling in for Mark Lenfest this evening. I may not be able to answer every question, but I will do my best and will follow up on any items that require additional information. Tonight we will provide an update on the projects, including a summary of overall progress, a review of activities completed during the past 30 days and overview of planned activities for the next 30 days, budget and invoicing updates, scheduled status, a look ahead of upcoming on site construction activities. And then at the end, we will take some questions if you have any. As you know, construction of the modular classrooms is now 100% complete. Beech procurement is nearing hundred percent completion with only a few remaining bid packages to be awarded. Construction progress has reached approximately 8% completion. This phase included some of the most challenging early site work, such as contaminated soil excavation and removal, pile installation and foundation construction. McLaughlin construction is approximately 99% complete. Only a limited number of punch list items remain and are being completed during off hours. The project is approximately 50% complete with respect to closeout activities. Hillside construction is approximately 85% complete. The addition is expected to be substantially complete by the end of this month. The building is anticipated to be ready for occupancy during the Christmas break. The remaining renovation work within the existing building will be completed next summer. Parkside and Southside construction is approximately 40% complete. The additions are anticipated to be completed by mid-February. Occupancy and moving are planned during the February school vacation. The remaining renovation work will be completed in phases through the summer of 2028. Last 30 days activities continued with the project coordination meetings for all active projects, group one, Hillside and McLaughlin continued. Punchlist work and project closeout activities continued, installation of remaining furniture, fixtures and equipment and technology items. Group two Parkside and Southside continued completion of punchlist items from the summer renovation phase. Construction of the additions progressed significantly. Building envelope, interior framing, MEP systems and interior finishes continue to advance. Beech Street Elementary School procurement progressed and is nearing 100% completion. Site work continued, including soil removal. Pile installation and structural concrete work pile installation has been completed. Coordination, monitoring and reporting activities with New Hampshire days remain ongoing related to soil management activities. Continued refinement of project budgets and schedules across all projects. Ongoing coordination and communication with district, city and project stakeholders. Next 30 days activities, continue weekly project meetings, construction oversight, budget management, schedule updates and stakeholder coordination across all projects. Continue closeout activities at McLaughlin and completion of the Hillside addition. Continue construction progress on the Parkside and Southside additions. Continue procurement, closeout and early construction activities at Beech Street. Continue New Hampshire DES coordination and reporting requirements related to soil activities at Beech. In addition to group one, group two and Beech, I would like to provide also some updates on the commissary kitchen and modular relocation projects. SMMA recently presented the Modular Classroom Relocation Plan and commissary kitchen renovation project at West High School to the school board. Design activities for both the modular relocations and commissary kitchen renovation are now underway. We are scheduling meetings with the districts, and we will coordinate the design coordination efforts with the districts, SMMA, and other stakeholders. The first modular classroom relocation will move units from Hillside to Jewett Street. The relocated modular classrooms are anticipated to be operational for the start of the next school year, which is the 2027-2028 school year. The commissary kitchen renovation at West High School is currently anticipated to follow a similar schedule. Once the design is complete, the project team will reassess and confirm the construction schedule for both projects. The overall project budget is included in the package distributed to the members. While this slide may be difficult to read, the detailed budget information is available in the monthly report. All projects currently remain within their approved budgets as additional projects reach completion and final costs are reconciled. The team will gain better certainty regarding the overall budget and available contingencies. We will continue to monitor project expenditures closely and provide regular budget updates to the committee. This slide serves as a placeholder for the project invoicing summary, and currently displays the previous month's invoice package that was submitted to the district. October invoices are currently being compiled and reviewed by LeftField. The October invoice package is expected to be submitted to the district for payment later this week. LeftField continues to review all invoices for accuracy and completeness prior to submission. Updated invoicing information will be included in the next monthly project report. Group one schedule update, this slide presents the current group one project schedule at Hillside. The addition remains on track for completion by the end of November. The addition is expected to be ready for occupancy during the Christmas school vacation break. Renovations within the existing building and the remaining site work are scheduled for completion during summer 2027. To facilitate completion of the site work, the existing modular classrooms will need to be relocated from the Hillside campus in early spring 2027. At McLaughlin, construction is substantially complete. The contractor is currently addressing the remaining punch list items, which are being coordinated with school staff and completed during off hours to minimize disruption. The project entered the closeout phase and the final documentation activities are underway. Group two schedule activities, construction at Parkside and Southside remains actively underway. The new additions at both schools are on track for completion by February 2027. Occupancy and moving to the additions are planned during the February 2027 school vacation break. Following occupancy of the additions, renovation work within the existing buildings will continue in phased sections to minimize disruption to school operations. Construction and renovation activities at both schools are currently scheduled to continue through the summer of 2028, with final completion anticipated by the end of summer 2028. Beech Street Elementary School schedule update, the timeline shown on the screen reflects the current construction schedule for the new Beech Street Elementary School. The construction was delayed by several months due to soil removal activities. The construction team successfully recovered the lost time and the project is now back on schedule. The majority of the soil removal work is complete. Foundation construction is currently underway. Structural steel erection is scheduled to begin within the next few weeks and will represent a major milestone for the project. Overall, the project remains on schedule and is targeted for completion in time for occupancy at the start of the 2028-2029 school year. An upcoming milestone for Beech Street Elementary School, the groundbreaking ceremony is scheduled for next Tuesday, November 17th at 10:30 a.m.. And we encourage all community members and project stakeholders to attend this important milestone event. The last slide deck is related to the onsite construction activities. And Harvey continues to update the project websites for each school project. Please feel free to reach out to LeftField if you have any questions regarding the construction activities.

School Committee Member Hamer: You indicated that the commissary development will happen. My question is, maybe looking ahead a little further, when do you anticipate the construction of commissary to begin at West High School?

H. Cobanoglu: The overall schedule is to complete the design by February 2027 and then go out to bidding early March. And once we have the general contractor, this is being procured separately, so it will be bid as a design bid build. It's not construction, it's more traditional methodology. First, the design will be completed, which will happen by February 2027, and then the project will be built. Once we have the general contractor they will work on the material submittals, shop drawings and be ready to start the construction early summer, right after school.

School Committee Member Hamer: So it sounds like potentially the summer of 2027 was when it would happen.

H. Cobanoglu: Correct. And, it will be done during the summer vacation.

Alderman Bonilla: I noticed Jewett will be getting 1 or 2 modulars by fall of 2027.

H. Cobanoglu: Harvey Construction they own, actually we just completed the procurement and the contract has not been signed yet, but as soon as the contract is signed they will start working on the design. They are being contracted for one relocation at this point which is Hillside’ s modulars, they will be moved from Hillside to Jewett Street. The second one will be later, but it will be in early 2028 from Southside to Bakersville. But we don't have any contractual commitment yet for the second relocation.

Chairman O'Connell: The modulars will be moved in whole. So there are either 10 or 12 classrooms in the modulars. Is it 12 at Hillside?

H. Cobanoglu: I think 13.

Chairman O'Connell: That's a whole building. And so that will be reconstructed at Jewett. So they'll have 13 classrooms and there are teacher rooms and bathrooms and all that in it. But it's everything that's at Hillside will be moved to Jewett so the children at Jewett and all those kids we put in there from Hallsville a few years back will have all those additional classrooms starting in the beginning of the school year 2027.

Alderman Bonilla: It'll be in the backyard, right? Where the old one is right now.

Chairman O'Connell: Where are the modulars being placed?

H. Cobanoglu: So that will be worked on during the pre-construction phase with Harvey. So they are going to hire an in-house designer and do all the utility designs, and they are going to look at the wetlands. They will obviously stay away from the wetlands. And probably it will be at the back of the street.

Alderman Bonilla: They have the old one there right now, I think still. Thank you for the clarity. Do you have any update on the concept design for the future field, soccer/basketball court at Beech Street?

H. Cobanoglu: That's still in review with DPW. I think they will need another two months to complete the conceptual design and report back.

Alderman Bonilla: They said two additional months?

H. Cobanoglu: Yes. Last time we spoke with them, they said 2 or 3 months and it was two weeks ago.

School Committee Member Turner: Exciting news about the groundbreaking on the 17th. My appreciation that the construction team was able to make up the lost time on Beech, keeping us on time in terms of opening for fall of 2028. And I guess that was due to, you said the soil removal delay was the cause, but the construction team was able to make that up. I appreciate the answers to the commissary and the Hillside questions. I know I have a Hillside student, but the vibe at Hillside is that everyone's very excited for the move over winter break in December. So keep up the good work.

Alderman Bonilla: You had said something about the groundbreaking. I know we had received individual invitations, but based on what you said, is it an open invitation to the community partners, or is it just individuals that RSVP? I haven't seen any postings on social media from the Manchester school district about it being open to the public. And if it is, I'd love to circulate that.

H. Cobanoglu: This is still an active construction site. I don't want to say it's an open invitation, but we can accommodate whoever wants to attend, but we need some notification. I know the district is coordinating all the invitations. If you have any people to be invited to the ceremony, please reach out and we can accommodate.

Alderman Bonilla: I didn't know it was an open invitation to everybody. I recognize, and I did think about it being a construction site, but I appreciate your clarification. Chairman O'Connell: I have a question with regard to the timeline at Hillside, and I'm particularly thinking about the field. So currently, Consigli is occupying half the field for Hillside with their construction trailers and they put paving on it at the end of the project, they're pulling out of there. And this project calls for them to bring the ground back to usable. When do you expect Consigli to vacate that playing field? What part of the project? When will they be leaving Hillside?

H. Cobanoglu: I can answer a little bit, I'm not day to day with the Hillside project. So Mark is I'm more day to day with Parkside, Southside and Beech. But this February, they will vacate the modulars. And then early spring, modulars will be relocated and all the sidewalks will start at that area and everything will be complete at the end of summer 2027.

Chairman O'Connell: So they're going to be finished with the construction completely, interior construction, the remodeling by the 1st of September of 2027.

H. Cobanoglu: Interior and exterior. Everything will be done by September.

Chairman O'Connell: At that point, what should be left to be done is just vacate that field. I just want to tag for people that when that field, when the construction leaves that field, there is a plan. The city has a plan on the CIP budget. There is a plan, we're carrying $750,000 on the city side to develop that field as a playing field. I mean, it is quite a shameful thing that that school has existed for 50 some years without a usable field next to it with 1100 kids in the school. I don't want this opportunity lost. I want to make sure there's coordination here as we come to the end of the project in a year from now, less than a year, September 2027. So it's a lot of time, but it's not a lot of time. It would make no sense for us to take their trailers out, dig up the pavement and prepare the ground and some earth and put some sod or seed on it. And then we as a city come in six months later and decide we're going to develop the field. So it's just important that there's coordination between DPW, this project for the completion of the schools, and the school district to ensure that we do the right thing between the various bodies. I have confidence that will happen, but I'm calling it out now because we've got a budget process that happens and that $750,000 would have to survive the budget within the CIP. That money's there. It just has to be used for that purpose. I want to make you all aware of it so that it's on everybody's radar.

H. Cobanoglu: Thank you for bringing that up. I will follow up with Mark and the district on that.

2. Monthly status and financial report submitted by LeftField for the period ending October 2026.

On motion of School Committee Member Turner , duly seconded by School

Committee Member Hamer , it was voted to accept the report and submit it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School Committee for informational purposes.

There being no further business, on motion of School Committee Member Turner , duly seconded by Alderman Bonilla , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee
